claims: Brock Lesnar appeared to retire from WWE at WrestleMania 42 on April 19, 2026.
Brock Lesnar lost to Oba Femi at WrestleMania 42.
The match between Brock Lesnar and Oba Femi lasted less than 5 minutes.
Brock Lesnar sat in the ring.
Brock Lesnar hugged his longtime manager Paul Heyman.
Brock Lesnar left his gloves and boots in the center of the ring.
Brock Lesnar left his gear in the ring.
Brock Lesnar's retirement was not immediately confirmed through an official corporate press release.
The actions taken are commonly recognized as a retirement gesture in wrestling.
Reports in early 2026 highlighted speculation about Brock Lesnar's future with a potential final match.
Brock Lesnar's career spans WWE, UFC, and NCAA wrestling
